questions: How can I track my parcel?
Can I check my delivery status?
I have not received my order
answer: You can track your order using the tracking link sent to your registered email. You can also check the order status in your account.
Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days. Delivery time may vary depending on your location.

questions: How do I cancel my order?
I want to cancel my order
answer: You can cancel your order from the My Orders section before it is shipped.

questions: How can I get a refund?
When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are generally processed within 5–7 business days after the returned product is received and approved.

questions: How can I return a product?
I want to return my order
Can I send back my product?
answer: You can request a return within 7 days of delivery, provided the product meets the return conditions.

questions: How can I pay for my order?
answer: We accept UPI, debit cards, credit cards and other available payment methods at checkout.
Cash on Delivery is available for eligible delivery locations and products. Check availability during checkout.

questions: What if I receive a broken item?
answer: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Please contact customer support with your order details and product photographs.

questions: This is not what I ordered
My package contains a different item
answer: Please contact customer support with your order ID and a photograph of the received product so we can assist you.

questions: How do I create an account?
answer: Click the Sign Up button, enter your details and follow the registration instructions to create an account.

questions: How can I reset my password?
I cannot log into my account
answer: Use the Forgot Password option on the login page and follow the instructions to reset your password.

questions: How can I contact customer support?
How do I talk to an agent?
answer: You can contact our customer support team through the Contact Us section on our website.

questions: How can I get a discount?
answer: You can find current discounts and promotional offers on our website. Check the Offers section for available deals.
Shipping charges depend on your order value and delivery location. The applicable charges are displayed at checkout.

questions: Can I change my delivery address?
How do I update my shipping address?
Can I edit my delivery details?
answer: You may update your delivery address before the order is shipped by contacting customer support.
